title: EnchantedMC
description: EnchantedMC is a network of custom tailored gamemodes, such as Skyblock & Prison.
body:
**EnchantedMC is a network of custom tailored gamemodes with unique content and a large player base.**

## Gamemodes
- Prison
- Dungeons
- Skyblock
- Factory
- Gens
- Survival

New maps are cycled for most gamemodes, resetting all players and bringing new content.
